basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the vibrant city of Seattle, I'm a software developer by day, Pokemon trainer by night. I've been navigating the digital world since dial-up and have a soft spot for classic car racing games. When I'm not coding or raiding gyms in Pokemon Go, you can find me exploring the local music scene or hiking the Pacific Northwest trails. Currently in a long-term relationship with my high school sweetheart, we're navigating the complexities of adult life together, one Reddit post at a time. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I've spent over a decade in the tech industry. A self-proclaimed autodidact, I constantly update my skills through online courses and community forums. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in building mobile applications and gaming algorithms.
